sentences.en: Like the banner, the design was based around the colour white.
sentences.zh: 就像横幅一样，设计主要围绕白色展开。

sentences.en: There was a banner on the wall that said "Happy Birthday."
sentences.zh: 墙上挂着一个横幅上写着‘生日快乐’。

sentences.en: Many people gathered under this banner of freedom.
sentences.zh: 许多人聚集在自由的旗帜下。

senses.zh: 用横幅装饰以大标题报道
